blocks.orig: On a wide stretch of beach on Zanzibar’s northwest coast, the Gold Zanzibar Beach House and Spa offers 76 spacious rooms designed in a blend of African and Arab styles with a modern twist! The property, located in the little town of Kendwa, features a large swimming pool with sun loungers, as well as direct beach access, so you can choose between saltwater or freshwater dips. Dining is varied, with four restaurants serving à la carte seafood by the sea to various international dishes. For extra indulgence, there is a spa that uses natural products, and evenings often call for cocktails and sunsets…best enjoyed at the beach restaurant with the sand between your toes.
blocks.html: Set on a broad beach along Zanzibar’s northwest coast, the Gold Zanzibar Beach House and Spa has 76 roomy rooms whose design combines African and Arab influences with a contemporary touch! The hotel lies in the little town of Kendwa and has direct access to the beach as well as a big pool surrounded by sun loungers, so a dip in salt or fresh water is always an option. Four restaurants give you plenty of variety, from seaside à la carte seafood to dishes from around the world. If you want to treat yourself, the spa works with natural products, and in the evening it is time for cocktails and sunsets…preferably at the beach restaurant, with your toes in the sand.
